name: mosofin
description: Financial review workflows for QuickBooks and other connected books through MosoFin: month-end close, P&L flux, balance sheet and trial balance review, A/R aging and collections, A/P payment runs and vendor spend, cash runway, budget vs actual, owner packs, and health sweeps across client workspaces for accounting firms. 42 workflows for bookkeepers, controllers, CFOs and owners, with a saved review profile so every analysis uses your materiality and targets. Read-only: it never posts, pays, sends or reconciles anything. Requires a MosoFin account.
